evidence.title: Mission Navigation Baseline
evidence.content: Mission route planning reports: direct route 40 NM; small detour approximately 55 NM; large detour approximately 80 NM. Normal cruise speed is 20 kt. Delivery deadline is 5.0 hours.

evidence.title: Leviathan Storm Tracking Report
evidence.content: Storm Leviathan is currently moving ENE at 15 kt.

evidence.title: Storm Exposure Assessment
evidence.content: Leviathan's strong-storm core radius is 15 NM and its outer impact radius is 30 NM. Direct transit through the strong-storm zone is expected to reduce safe vessel speed to approximately 10 kt.

evidence.title: Storm Clearance Forecast
evidence.content: Leviathan is forecast to clear the current main route in approximately 2.5 hours.

evidence.title: Small Detour Navigation Estimate
evidence.content: The small detour is approximately 55 NM. Expected safe speed is 15 kt, producing an estimated travel time of 3.67 hours.

evidence.title: Route Damage Risk Assessment
evidence.content: Estimated damage risk: DIRECT 35-65%; SMALL_DETOUR 10-25%; LARGE_DETOUR 0-5%; WAIT_DIRECT 5-15%.
